Treatment summary
The patient presented after a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a distal radius wrist fracture, and the reported
mechanism is consistent with this type of injury. Over the course of 16 visits, treatment followed a typical progression:
immobilization, followed by supervised range-of-motion exercises and graduated strengthening, with visit frequency
tapering as function returned. Examination findings at intake and in later visits show tenderness and reduced grip
stregnth over the fracture site that support the diagnosis, while several other neurological and vascular tests were
within normal limits. No prior injury to the same wrist or forearm is documented in the available history. The billing
record shows two similar charges entered on the same day, which are currently under review for accuracy. At
discharge the patient had regained most functional range and was released to independent home exercise.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
